analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (1,171,000 KRW) vs SMA5 (1,139,200 KRW) / SMA20 (1,255,100 KRW) / SMA50 (1,463,120 KRW): Above short-term SMA5, below mid-term SMA20/SMA50, indicating a sideways trend.
· Significantly below SMA100 (1,625,189 KRW) / SMA200 (1,531,617 KRW): Mid-to-long term trend remains weak.
· 52-week position (27.0%): High relative to historical lows but significantly down from highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (34.8→43.2): Exited oversold but failed to recover above 50, preparing to enter neutral territory.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-8183.9041→2887.3665): Improvement observed from negative territory, suggesting potential bottoming.
· Bollinger Bands current price position (Mid-band 1,255,100 KRW): Sideways movement around the mid-band, exploring direction. Bandwidth at 44.56% indicates sustained volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (1,089,000 KRW): Confirmed support above the 5-day low (1,044,000 KRW).
· Swing resistance (1,317,000 KRW): Potential to test resistance if the mid-band (SMA20) is breached on the upside.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern: 5-day high 1,212,000 KRW, 5-day low 1,044,000 KRW. 20-day high 1,587,000 KRW, 20-day low 1,044,000 KRW. Sideways pattern confirmed within the 20-day high/low range for both 5-day high/low.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.58): Below the 5-day average, indicating low confidence in trend reversal.
· Current phase diagnosis: Potential accumulation phase. Consider buying on confirmation of support at 1,089,000 KRW and a breakout above resistance at 1,317,000 KRW.
